g.text: Heap sort: the array IS a complete binary tree
For index i: left child = 2i + 1, right child = 2i + 2. Values move; index-to-node mapping stays.
1. Input tree: heap order does not hold
Start at last parent i = 2. Compare 3 with children 6 and 5.
Yellow nodes: the parent and children under inspection.
Next parent i = 1: compare 1 with children 2 and 7.
Yellow nodes: the parent and children under inspection.
Next parent i = 0: compare 4 with children 7 and 6.
Yellow nodes: the parent and children under inspection.
Root 7 is maximum. Each parent is >= both children.
Heap order is partial: the array is not yet sorted.
Magenta arrows: the next exchange. Build bottom-up so child subtrees are heaps first.
